displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists Detic in the Detection Segmentation area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Detecting Twenty-thousand Classes using Image-level Supervision”. The page names Xingyi Zhou, Ishan Misra as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
